components.name: Primary navigation
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:27px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}.ds-nav button{min-height:44px;padding:0 1px;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;background:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Avenir Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif;}.ds-nav button[aria-current]{color:var(--accent);border-bottom-color:var(--accent);}.ds-nav button:hover{color:var(--accent);}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Selected book row
components.description: A book in the linear browsing alternative.
components.css: .ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:29px minmax(0,1fr) 82px;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:76px;padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--selected);color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-family:'Avenir Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif;}.ds-row button{text-align:left;padding:6px 0;border:0;background:none;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;}.ds-row strong{display:block;font:400 15px/1.45 var(--serif);}.ds-row small{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-family:'Avenir Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif;}.ds-row button:hover strong{color:var(--accent);}.ds-row button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px;}

narrative.overview: Pathfinder uses warm paper, charcoal text, serif book titles, and small red annotations. Readers can choose a next book while keeping the branching story visible. Rules and open space separate content; sans-serif controls remain clear. This direction replaces the former dark campaign-war-room style.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white surfaces and charcoal text.
Self-hosted serif book titles with sans-serif controls.
Muted red for actions, selection, and reading direction.
Thin rules and flat surfaces with little ornament.

rules.name: The Annotation Rule
rules.body: Use red to identify an action, location, or connection. Do not fill large content surfaces with it.

rules.name: The Book Title Rule
rules.body: Use serif text for book names. Keep controls in sans-serif so actions remain easy to identify.

dos: Do keep book titles readable and controls explicit.
Do use rules and space to separate related content.
Do pair colour with labels or symbols for reading state.
Do keep a linear alternative to graph-based browsing.
Do distinguish curated suggestions from an official reading order.
donts: Do not restore the dark war-room palette or decorative glow.
Do not use campaign insignia as general control decoration.
Do not copy unlicensed cover art or proprietary logos.
Do not expose story spoilers in an always-open visual summary.
